# Qiao Partners

> Qiao Partners connects European companies and distributors directly with leading Chinese factories. Competitive prices, one EU counterparty, quality checked before delivery. Headquartered in Warsaw.

Qiao Partners is an independent China–Europe market entry and strategic business development firm based in Warsaw, Poland. It is a trading partner and business developer that connects European demand with Chinese supply: it opens European markets and finds local buyers for Chinese manufacturers, selects manufacturers by hand against each buyer's needs, ensures certification, product quality and capacity, and manages the trade and the account. It is not a law firm, tax adviser, certification body or investment adviser, and it does not invest or give investment advice.

## Services
- [Direct Sourcing](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#direct-sourcing): We source directly from the producer, with no layers of agents in between. Factories are selected by hand for each request, from manufacturers we know and have worked with, so you get competitive prices and a supplier that fits your specification, volumes and timing.
- [Trade & Counterparty Risk](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#trade-risk): Qiao Partners buys from the producer and sells to you. Your contract, invoice and warranty are with an EU company headquartered in Warsaw, and we carry the counterparty risk towards the factory: payment terms, deposits, delivery and performance. Risk management is our background.
- [Quality, Certification & Delivery](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#quality-delivery): Before goods leave the factory we make sure they meet EU requirements and your specification: certification, factory audits and pre-shipment inspection with accredited partners. We then handle shipping, customs and delivery to your site, and coordinate after-sales with the producer.
- [Distributors & Manufacturers](https://qiaopartners.eu/services/#partnerships): For European distributors we set up regular supply programmes with stable pricing and stock planning. For Chinese manufacturers we find European companies and distributors that need their products, and manage the relationship on the ground.

## Industries
- Battery Energy Storage: Utility-scale BESS, C&I battery cabinets, Cells and modules, Power conversion systems, Energy management systems
- Electric Trucks & Buses: Electric trucks, Electric buses, Light commercial vehicles, Charging infrastructure, Spare parts
- Engines & Power Generation: Diesel and gas engines, Generator sets, CHP units, Marine and industrial engines, Spare parts
- Mining & Construction Machinery: Excavators and loaders, Crushers and screens, Drilling rigs, Conveyors, Underground mining equipment
- Data Centre Equipment: Fibre-optic cables and connectivity, Power cables, Racks and enclosures, Cooling systems, UPS and switchgear
- Biomethane & Biogas Equipment: Membrane upgrading units, Digesters and tanks, Compressors, Gas treatment, CHP units
- Solar & Grid Equipment: Solar modules, Inverters, Transformers, Switchgear, Cables and mounting systems
- Aluminium Products: Extrusions and profiles, Sheet, coil and foil, Windows, doors and façades, Automotive and battery-enclosure parts, Heat sinks and housings
